verdict.rationale: Navan clearly offers the parts of the story in one platform: travel booking with global inventory, expense management and reimbursements, connected corporate cards, card-transaction APIs, and receipt scanning. However, nothing in the evidence shows these items automatically grouping into a single report tied to a trip's itinerary. Missing for 10: documented auto-grouping of booking, card and receipt expenses into one per-trip report, linkage of expenses to the itinerary, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
